posts.title: One ticket a day, keeps the doctor away
posts.description: The burn isn’t always the volume of work. It’s jumping between tickets all day and paying the context-switch tax fifty times.

posts.title: The 0.1x engineer
posts.description: We have 200 features. Customers use about 20% of them. A throwaway Slack joke turned out to be a surprisingly good engineering philosophy.

posts.title: Whose name is on it
posts.description: Code review, QA sign-off, and retros often move responsibility around until nobody is actually holding it.
